start: Exercise page of a main barbell lift (Bench Press) with a best set logged and a body weight logged on or before that day

steps.action: Open the exercise page and look under the chart
user_sees: Line 'Strength level: Intermediate' with a trophy icon
must_not: The body weight, a body-weight ratio or a kilo target shown anywhere on the line

user_sees: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, Elite, each with its meaning; the member's level marked ' · your level'
Chips 'Compare me with': Everyone, Men, Women
must_not: The body weight shown in the sheet or read out by the screen reader
No level marked as the member's own

steps.action: Tap 'Women', close the sheet, leave the page and open it again
user_sees: The level line worked out against women's levels
'Women' still chosen when the sheet opens again
must_not: The choice back on the old chip after reopening
The level line not changing to match the new choice

start: Exercise page of Squat with a best set, but no body weight ever logged

user_sees: Line 'Log your body weight to see your strength level' with a scale icon and an arrow
must_not: A made-up level shown with no body weight
The 'What this means' sheet opening from this line

steps.action: Tap the line, log a body weight on Body weight, come back with back
user_sees: The line now reads 'Strength level: ...' at once
must_not: The old 'Log your body weight' line still showing after a weight was logged
A crash coming back to the page

start: Exercise page of a lift that has no strength level (a cable or machine exercise, or the member's own exercise), or a main lift with no best set yet

user_sees: No strength level line at all; the rest of the page as usual
must_not: A 'Strength level' line or a 'Log your body weight' prompt on an exercise that has no levels
An empty gap where the line would be

start: Profile body figure set to Female, the member never picked who to compare with

steps.action: Open a main lift's page and tap the strength level line
must_not: 'Everyone' chosen for a member who picked Female

steps.action: Pick 'Everyone', then change the body figure in Profile back to Male, open the page again
user_sees: 'Everyone' still chosen (the member's own choice wins)
must_not: The choice changed by the body figure after the member picked one

steps.action: Log a new best set or a new body weight and open the page
user_sees: The level worked out again; it can move up or down
must_not: An old level kept after a new best lift on another day

start: Any main lift with a level shown

steps.action: Read the sheet's first paragraph and turn on the screen reader over the line
user_sees: 'Your body weight stays private and is never shown.'
Screen reader: 'Strength level: Intermediate. What this means'
must_not: The body weight, a ratio, or a target kilo figure from which the body weight can be worked out
The level or body weight sent to the gym or shown on a share picture
